title: MiniDSH 2.0: One Runtime, Every Surface

approvals.note: In plan mode the user was asked "Which treatment should the MiniDSH launch film be built on?" with three candidates and answered "A: One session, three surfaces (Recommended)"; in the same round they chose WSL for the terminal and web with the desktop on Windows, the official v2.0.0 installer, and the font-size reading of the 36 px text bar, then approved the plan (treatment A, refined as A-prime by a creative review the same day).

next: Capture the live takes (terminal and web in WSL, desktop on Windows) once the user has set the demo keys and installed the app; then cues.ts, the pilot look check on the permission beat.
